title: Living Town: complete upgraded territory in actual gameplay
initial_mode: Normal resident selector. Before the timed tour, public LifeMode.start_life(aria), speed key3, real waiting to tick90, pause key0 and LifeMode.begin_select() establish morning without relocating Aria. The pre-roll is included in the measured boot prefix and trimmed from delivery.
boot_prefix: Report movie_boot_frames_to_trim from Engine.get_frames_drawn at the defined tour start. Trim that many captured boot frames before the840-second narration timeline. Verify actual output frame count independently.

camera_api.owner: Harness priority49, between LifeMode priority0 and WorldView3D priority50
camera_api.interpolation: Smoothstep of integer tour frame/FPS, independent of OS wall clock and Sim tick rewinds
camera_api.inspections: Presentation only: pause LifeMode processing/HUD and hide observer cards; keep the chapter label. Restore the compact activity feed and resident controls before real input. No actor address or clock edits.
camera_api.gameplay_hud: Five needs remain visible in the compact resident card. Chapter2 uses actual viewport clicks to expand and collapse activity history and daily wishes while the clock stays paused. Public clock buttons and existing keyboard bindings remain available during ordinary play.
camera_api.coordinate_system: Camera centers are canonical px through the existing projection; geography listed below is original Blender XY meters.

source_bindings.policy: Harness binds current projection, exact staged visual chunk set, character manifest and its own bytes at recording time. Composition rejects stale or altered sources.

allowed_core_entry: Actual viewport input -> existing Main/LifeMode -> Sim transactions; public start_life selection only. Read-only Sim queries/signals supply QA evidence. Pre-roll uses public LifeMode.start_life(aria), speed keys, live waiting to tick90, and LifeMode.begin_select().
prohibited: Direct agent placement or option/needs writes
Clock or Simstate assignments by the director
Treating architectural inspection as resident travel
narration_notes: The840second full route includes genuine new-district and reserve travel, the walked return to core, actions, stairs and save/load.
Camera inspection is explicitly labelled. The route is representative gameplay, not every-room player traversal.
The preview is a shortened framing and startup check; it is not full-route evidence.
EdgeTTS subtitles use measured word boundaries. Composition preserves the full original HUD and appends a96pixel matte band.
No universal hardware performance or physics certification is implied.
recording_format_policy: AVI only. Reject missing recorded frames; never synthesize or pad gameplay frames.44100Hz/18FPS provides2450actualaudioframes pervideo frame.
